title: prepared fallback 명령 목록의 vector 수집을 연결 목록으로 대체
existingWork: _metal4PreparedReplay vector의 포인터 수집/원 prefix 복원 순회가 남아 있음. capacity 재사용은 이미 있음.
missingEvidence: 복사·순회를 줄일 수 있어도 lifetime bookkeeping과 추가 분기가 늘 수 있음.
requiredBoundary: 보유 node가 async pool에 조기 반환되지 않도록 하고 prefix/suffix/취소/reset 순서를 유지.

risk.function: 중간: 원 prefix/suffix 순서, tail, timestamp activation fallback이 틀리면 재생이 달라짐.
risk.lifetime: 높음: 보유 node를 async pool에 먼저 반환하면 _next가 변경·재사용됨. adoption/취소/reset까지 소유해야 함.
risk.memory: head/tail 자체는 작지만 중복 보유·cycle·잘못된 lifetime은 메모리 증가 가능.

strategy: Prepared an exclusively owned replay head/tail chain. The existing _next belongs to replay only after completed encoding and before detached pool return. It is never concurrently owned by replay and the async pool. Restore splices prefix/suffix in O(1); no new field in every command.
acceptance: Explicit state table owns every command from capture to adoption, cancel, reset or fallback; exactly one pool return
tests: Existing recording-ownership cases: empty/single/long prefix, suffix restoration, cancellation, secondary and simultaneous use
Delayed pool return and original command order oracle; no cycles or duplicate release
dependencyMeaning: Interactions require re-review; they are not permission to enable all related changes together.
designStage: Exact source capsules where named; broader missing-target/ownership/pass designs remain gated where stated
stopRule: Any unclosed correctness/lifetime counterexample, changed parent, failed check or unclear measurement stops this module. Preserve failure evidence; no automatic replay.
rollback: Prepared source module: exact reverse patch only against its postimage, refresh mtimes and rebuild all affected headers. No-code module: active product remains unchanged; no invented reverse patch.
